3. `C(=Cc1ccccc1OCc1ccccc1)CCc1ccc2ccccc2c1` → `O=CCCc1ccc2ccccc2c1.c1ccc(COc2ccccc2C[P+](c2ccccc2)(c2ccccc2)c2ccccc2)cc1` (Wittig)
